display.purpose: Condensed uppercase caps (Big Shoulders 700, line-height 0.92) — stencilled equipment lettering for headlines only.

body.purpose: Archivo 400-600, 13-14.5px — dense console prose and table cells.

label.purpose: Courier Prime 700 (ships 400/700 only), 12px, .16em uppercase — the tag on every jack, lamp, number, and action.

shadows.name: seat
shadows.purpose: Rows, chips, plates, panels at rest.

shadows.name: engrave
shadows.purpose: The plate treatment — light catching a routed edge.

motion.name: enter
motion.purpose: The one easing: fade-up arrival (.4-.5s) and the rule drawing open (.65s).

motion.name: lamp-pulse
motion.purpose: Only on .lamp.live — an armed line. Suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: caret-blink

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The brass plate: mono uppercase pill for the one action that matters.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; background: var(--cta, #C89B3C); color: var(--cta-text, #1A1510); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Courier Prime', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.10); cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cta-hover, #DBAF52); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #D3A648); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action: faint cream fill, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; background: rgba(239,231,211,0.05); color: var(--ink, #EFE7D3); border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(239,231,211,0.18)); border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Courier Prime', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s ease, border-color .18s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface, #241E16); border-color: var(--ink-3, #A2967C); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #D3A648); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Badge
components.description: Jewel-lamp status badge; danger tone shown — red means a guard finding or a live line.
components.css: .ds-badge-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 26px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Courier Prime', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--danger-deep, #EE7052); background: var(--danger-wash, rgba(226,89,63,0.14)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger, #E2593F) 38%, transparent); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-lamp { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; box-shadow: 0 0 5px 1px currentColor; }

components.name: Engraved Plate
components.description: The card replacement: a brass-edged strip that names a thing, never boxes a paragraph.
components.css: .ds-plate { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(239,231,211,0.18)); border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(239,231,211,0.05), rgba(0,0,0,0.18)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(239,231,211,0.08), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4); font-family: 'Courier Prime', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2, #C9BDA3); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Smoked Glass Panel
components.description: The console surface: smoked bakelite glass with an inset cream edge.
components.html:
CALL QUEUE

Every dispatch writes its row before it dials.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--bg-glass, rgba(36,30,22,0.72)); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(120%); border: 1px solid var(--line-2, rgba(239,231,211,0.09)); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(239,231,211,0.07); padding: 22px; max-width: 360px; } .ds-panel-eyebrow { font-family: 'Courier Prime', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2, #C9BDA3); } .ds-panel-body { margin-top: 8px; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ink, #EFE7D3); }

components.name: Avatar
components.description: One material for every person: bakelite disc, brass ring, cream initials — never a per-name hue.
components.css: .ds-avatar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 34% 30%, var(--surface-2, #2C251C), var(--bg-2, #1D1812) 70%); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #D3A648) 45%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(239,231,211,0.10), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.45); color: var(--ink-2, #C9BDA3); font-family: 'Courier Prime', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Live Lamp
components.description: The jewel lamp; pulsing red means a line is actually armed.
components.css: .ds-lamp-row { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Courier Prime', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--danger-deep, #EE7052); } .ds-lamp { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; box-shadow: 0 0 6px 1px currentColor, inset 0 -1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.5), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.45); animation: ds-lamp-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-lamp-pulse { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 5px 1px currentColor, inset 0 -1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.5), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.45); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 12px 3px currentColor, inset 0 -1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.5), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.45); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-lamp { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Every screening call is a patch on the exchange board; OpenLine is the operator who never sleeps. The whole surface is an electromechanical telephone exchange: a bakelite near-black ground, brass jacks and cords, cream engraved labels, jewel-lamp status lights, condensed stencilled display caps, and typewriter mono. The product phones real people and spends real money, so the world's first job is legibility: whether this screen can dial someone must never be ambiguous, and the lamps have to tell the truth.

Structure is carried by plates, rules, and leader lines — never by card shells. A plate names a thing; it does not box a paragraph. Sections are delimited by hairline rules that draw open left to right (the product is called OpenLine), and dotted leader lines bind related content across space the way a ledger binds a name to a figure. The console is dense but calm; the landing is the exchange floor itself — the board, one glowing cord, and a perforated cream ticker tape printing the transcript.
keyCharacteristics: Bakelite ground, cream ink, one brass accent, jewel-lamp status colors
No card shells: plates, rules, and leader lines carry structure
Typewriter mono for every label, number, and action; condensed caps for display
Red is a lamp, not a paint — danger and live lines only
Honest machinery: absences are printed ("NO NUMBER ON FILE"), never faked

rules.name: The Red Lamp Rule
rules.body: Red lights only where something is actually wrong or actually live: a guard finding, a refusal, an armed line, the "Calls are live" chip. Red anywhere else dilutes the safety story, and the safety story is the product.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: One brass accent per view. Two accents competing means neither is the point. Avatars obey this too: one bakelite-and-brass treatment for every person, never a per-name hue.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Never write a hex literal in a component. Every value is a token in app/globals.css.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime ships 400 and 700 only. Never request 500/600 in mono — the browser would fake it. Buttons and labels use 700.

rules.name: The Mono Voice Rule
rules.body: Everything the machine says or counts is mono: labels, numbers, scores, phone fragments, IDs, transcripts, and every button ("START CALLING", not "Start calling").

rules.name: The Black Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are pure black at low alpha. A grey or colored shadow does not exist on this ground.

dos: Do use tokens for every color, radius, and shadow; globals.css is the only place a raw value lives.
Do keep one brass accent per view and let the status lamps carry state.
Do put every label, number, and action in Courier Prime (400/700 only), uppercase where it is machinery.
Do mask phone numbers everywhere (+91•••••4321) — screenshots of this UI end up in a published demo.
Do state absences honestly ("NO NUMBER ON FILE", amber) instead of faking a value.
Do keep all text pairs at ≥4.5:1 on their actual ground — measured: --ink-3 is 6.3:1 on --bg and 5.65:1 on --surface; the danger-wash pairing is 4.7:1.
Do pair every color-coded state with a word or shape — never color alone.
donts: Don't use red outside danger and live-line meaning. The Red Lamp Rule is product law and predates this world.
Don't draw card shells. Plates name, rules delimit, leader lines bind; a bordered box around prose is the old world leaking back.
Don't soften the guard, consent, or disclosure presentation to make a screen prettier — the safety story is the demo.
Don't request mono weights 500/600, use the display face in sentence case, or give avatars per-name hues.
Don't add gradient blobs, mesh heroes, lavender/indigo, centered-everything, or emoji headings.
Don't ship .reveal on a page without the <noscript> unhide.
